verdict.rationale: Abacum's own marketing says it builds P&L, balance sheet and cash flow statements from live ERP actuals, so the three-statement part of the story is covered. The drill-down part rests only on a one-word claim that numbers are "traceable," which does not show that a user can click any figure through to its source transactions. Edit-history auditing is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented drill-down from any statement figure to underlying source records/transactions, detail on statement views and their configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
